tasks.description: Let the English saved plant card record a due routine soil check using the accepted owner-scoped outbox and reload the new date after canonical confirmation.
constraints: Accepted base 8046790. Developer must return a valid unified Git patch incl exact current context with separate diff --git headers. The controller applies and tests.

Expose an EN action to mark a due/overdue routine check only for a current validated routineContext from the existing recommendation GET, with same plant ID and care revision. Check the device local date using existing ISO day/time helpers; do not show an action from a generic recommendation or stale/paused projection. Do not mark watering or presentation success on click.

Use pendingRoutineCompletion, enqueueRoutineCompletion and retryRoutineCompletion from the existing repository. Restore pending on reopen and exact retry after loss, handle rejected/unconfirmed outcomes without false success, guard owner/session and pending edits/deletion. After canonical confirmation refresh GET, so the new date appears and journal confirmation reflects the existing intended sync. No new transport/store/projection, undo and reminders out of scope.

Add one isolated DEBUG fixture that returns a due routine context and simulates first reply loss, exact retry, real linkage shape for care_tasks/care_entries and advancement asserted in testRoutineSoilCheckCompletesAfterRestart. Test same card and absence of duplicate/false action. Reuse helpers and keep previous EN scenarios. No staging/network calls in the fixture.

acceptance_criteria.description: Build, diff and unit gate pass with production transport unchanged.
Targeted EN XCUITest covers due action, exact pending retry across restart and confirmed next date.
